# GIA Blessed Trucking Inc

> New Jersey trucking company and for-hire motor carrier of property (except household goods). Hauls full truckload general freight and intermodal containers on interstate authority across the lower 48 states, with dispatch available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

- USDOT number: 3875433
- MC number: MC-1420159
- Authority: verify on FMCSA SAFER: https://safer.fmcsa.dot.gov/query.asp?searchtype=ANY&query_type=queryCarrierSnapshot&query_param=USDOT&query_string=3875433
- Phone (dispatch, 24/7): (347) 825-1155
- Email: officemanager@giablessedtrucking.com
- Quotes: https://giablessedtrucking.com/#quote

## Services

- [Full truckload freight](https://giablessedtrucking.com/#services): dedicated truck for dry general freight, scheduled pickups, run direct to the receiver.
- [Intermodal container trucking](https://giablessedtrucking.com/#services): container loads moved between terminals and warehouses, delivered to appointment.
- [Regional & long-haul trucking](https://giablessedtrucking.com/#services): interstate lanes out of New Jersey across the lower 48, one-off or recurring.
